startup_controller.name: P1-r3 sampled computed-torque static-midpoint startup only
startup_controller.design_derivation: Nominal frozen inverse-dynamics double-integrator ZOH: Kp=(1-r)^2/Delta0^2, Kd=(3-2r-r^2)/(2*Delta0), r=0.25, Delta0=1 ms. Fixed same gains in every cell. These poles are a nominal design rationale, not a nonlinear/sample-hold stability certificate.
startup_controller.gain_selection: New startup-only engineering choice frozen before any r3 test; r2 contains no numerical computed-torque proposal. No gain sweep or pass-conditioned selection.
startup_controller.execution_controller: Unchanged approved Slotine-Li Lambda=5/s and kappa=10/s; startup law ends at measured t=0.

initial_state: physical joint midpoint; qd=0; z=-Ko*M(q)*qd; dhat=0 at physical time -0.156

prehold_stop_criteria.position: abs(q-qmid)<=0.01 rad per joint throughout attempted hold
prehold_stop_criteria.velocity: abs(qd)<=0.02 rad/s per joint throughout attempted hold
prehold_stop_criteria.torque: abs(actual held tau)<=tau_max; no ideal clamp or reaction torque
prehold_stop_criteria.state: finite state and original physical h,psi1,speed,manipulability checks at retained stage/end samples
prehold_stop_criteria.observer: post-control diagnostic excess max(abs(d-dhat)-varpi)<=0 Nm at retained stages/end samples; no enlarged bounds
prehold_stop_criteria.on_first_failure: Stop that cell after retaining the first failed substep and dense-interpolant diagnostics; apply no additional torque or state update. Other predeclared C4 cells are independent numerical comparisons, never retuning.

prehold_continuous_check.method: For every attempted RK4 substep, find all component extrema of its standard cubic continuous extension on theta in [0,1]; check q deviation and qd limits at endpoints and stationary roots. Also check RK4 stage samples.
prehold_continuous_check.claim: Extrema of a numerical interpolant only. No verified ODE error enclosure, interval state box or continuous-time safety proof is inferred. An observed violation suffices to reject this development candidate.

observer_semantics: Coupled continuous q,qd,z RK4 using measured stage states and exact actually applied held torque. No reset at zero. Plant disturbance uses signed physical time; envelope elapsed=t+T_pre.
sampled_observer_sensitivity: Outside this frozen coupled-observer candidate. Not run; no physical sampled/delayed observer guarantee is inferred.

A2_reference.initial_rule: measured P1 endpoint q,qd; qdd_ref(0)=0 proposed

endpoint: Actual measured completed prehold q,qd,z at physical t=0 only. Instantiate the frozen Hermite rule, preserve propagated varpi, check previous torque and physical h/psi1/speed/manipulability, solve full original 43-row QP with the actual execution controller and reference at zero. Reuse this solve for first applied input; no second favorable fixture.

physical_state.criterion: q_min<=q<=q_max; abs(qd)<=vmax; W>=w_min^2; h>=0; initial psi1>=0; report raw physical slacks
physical_state.evaluation: control instants and retained plant RK4 stages; sampled evidence only, no between-sample certification

raw_CBF_rows.criterion: All original 43 raw slacks >=0 at every QP application; any negative raw slack is FAIL even near numerical resolution
raw_CBF_rows.scope: QP satisfaction at updates is not a continuous-time invariance proof

applied_torque.criterion: abs(tau_applied)<=tau_max at all retained stages; no post-QP clipping or fabricated fallback
applied_torque.on_failure: Record A2 FAIL and stop development state advance before actuation

observer_envelope.criterion: abs(dhat_i-d_i)<=varpi_i(physical_t+T_pre); maximum signed excess <=0 N m for every joint
observer_envelope.truth_access: post-control diagnostic only; never used for command, observer, time selection or precondition
observer_envelope.scope: Strict proposed numerical diagnostic; no sampled-observer certificate; continuous ideal envelope may fail under discretization

QP.additional: Log status, iterations, complementarity, duality gap, correction and runtime; all complete rows and torque box must pass; full T27 remains open

refinement.grid: Original C4 plus mandatory finer confirmation, indexed by cohorts
refinement.comparison_rule: For each factor compare adjacent cells at fixed other factor. Each metric difference must be <= max(approved absolute tolerance, approved relative_refinement*max(abs(values))). Also disclose cross-diagonal differences.

thresholds.zero_intervention_kind: APPROVED NUMERICAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; not certified solver error
thresholds.T29_source: Action_2026-10-31.docx Protocol v1.0 §8.1; no original T29 worksheet present in Tasks_2026.xlsx

refinement.additional: Report terminal errors and envelope excess for every cell. Reuse physical clock, T_pre and declared reference rule; no gain or threshold retuning. Fixed task duration is not a free-time planning result.
refinement.failure: Any failed metric, missing cell or engineering/audit prerequisite means numerical HOLD. No post-result threshold change.

terminal_task.prehold_endpoint_rule: Do not substitute midpoint for measured endpoint; record each C4 endpoint and reference coefficients, disclose any target differences before comparison

A2_acceptance.evidence_level: USER_AUTHORIZED_LEVEL_2_NUMERICAL_SAMPLED_ONLY; no independent review, hardware or publication claim
A2_acceptance.approval: Execution scope supplied by the user instruction recorded above; independent signatures remain null

strict_actuation: Cold ProxQP 0.7.2 with unchanged approved settings. Reject any negative raw row even if normalized T29 residual passes. No post-QP clipping, solver retries, softened rows, fallback or recovery. Stop before additional torque/state advance; preserve attempted step on a diagnostic failure.
energy_quadrature: Execution-only modeled non-regenerative shared-bus electrical energy: integrate phi_epsilon(sum_i(tau_i*qd_i+k_r_i*tau_i^2)) with same RK4 stage quadrature. Excludes prehold and w_t*T objective term; fixed .25 s is not an optimized duration.
refinement_min_slack_definition: Minimum raw 43-row slack divided by its approved row scale over accepted QP applications on the execution horizon. Failed solve/candidate rows are retained separately and cause failure, never zeroed. Physical and observer sample slacks also checked separately.

fixed_acceptance_thresholds.zero_intervention_kind: APPROVED NUMERICAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; not certified solver error
fixed_acceptance_thresholds.T29_source: Action_2026-10-31.docx Protocol v1.0 §8.1; no original T29 worksheet present in Tasks_2026.xlsx

failure_reporting: Run every frozen cell and retain all failures. No gain, threshold, duration, reference, disturbance or grid retuning after freeze. GO requires all cells, both cohorts including diagonals, read-only trace audits and engineering prerequisites. No automatic third candidate.
protected_parameters: approved Gaz model and its exact evaluator bytes
K_o, Lambda, kappa, alpha_1, alpha_2, alpha_v
disturbance amplitude, phase, signed global clock
original C4 grid and all fixed acceptance thresholds; added confirmation grid fixed before tests

execution_sampling.formula: r_k=unchanged Slotine-Li request(q_k,qd_k,reference(t_k),dhat_k). u_0=r_0; u_k=r_k+0.5*(r_k-r_{k-1}) for k>=1. The complete current-state hard QP filters u_k; actual QP torque is ZOH.
execution_sampling.rationale: The r3 request frozen at the start of each interval has first-order control-period error. The two-step causal quadrature approximates the interval-average request with second-order consistency for smooth requests; bootstrap contributes an O(Delta^2) global error. This is not a nonlinear stability proof.
execution_sampling.history: Fresh execution instance in each cell; no preparation-controller history, no future reference sample/state/estimate or true disturbance. One proposal per attempted QP. Endpoint solve reused for first torque. Failure ends cell, no retry or reused history.
execution_sampling.diagnostics: Log original continuous request, previous request, sampling correction and update index. QP intervention measured against the actual AB2 request; sampling correction separately reported to avoid hiding the controller change.
execution_sampling.additional_criterion: Both original C4 and finer-confirmation cohorts must pass all four fixed-factor comparisons and both disclosed diagonals. This strengthens rather than relaxes the old refinement rule.
